'''Gorvich''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] of the [[Old Tion Brotherhood]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He lived in the city of [[Maslovar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] and for total price of fifty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he helped [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] to use his [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to get to [[Reaver Station]].
